items.title: Tata Altroz CNG AMT Launch Price Rs 8.69 Lakh to Rs 10.77 Lakh – 5 Variants
items.summary: Tata Motors PV has launched the new Altroz iCNG AMT in India, making it the first and only premium hatchback in the country to offer an automatic transmission with a factory-fitted CNG powertrain The post Tata Altroz CNG AMT Launch Price Rs 8.69 Lakh to Rs 10.77 Lakh – 5 Variants appeared first on RushLane .

items.title: Range Rover Sport SV Launch Price Rs 2.05 Cr – 626 bhp, V8, 3.8s 0-100
items.summary: Range Rover Sport SV (Pure SV) has been launched in the country for Rs 2.05 Crore (Ex-sh), below the SV Edition Two The post Range Rover Sport SV Launch Price Rs 2.05 Cr – 626 bhp, V8, 3.8s 0-100 appeared first on RushLane .

items.title: 2026 Honda NX500 E-Clutch India Launch Price Rs 7.44 Lakh
items.summary: The addition of E-Clutch technology has significantly increased the price of the NX500. At Rs 7.44 lakh, the E-Clutch version costs Rs 1.11 lakh more than the outgoing conventional clutch version The post 2026 Honda NX500 E-Clutch India Launch Price Rs 7.44 Lakh appeared first on RushLane .

items.title: Skoda Auto India unveils upgraded Kodiaq range with Lounge variant, ADAS upgrades
items.summary: The Kodiaq Sportline gets a key upgrade for 2026 with the addition of a full suite of advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS), including adaptive cruise control, lane assist, blind spot detection, rear traffic alert and exit warning.

items.title: Hyundai pins hopes on new SUV launches in FY27 to regain lost ground
items.summary: The company is betting on two new SUVs in FY27 to drive volumes and regain ground in the Indian market, where domestic OEMs overtook the Korean carmaker in FY26 amid intensifying competition in the SUV segment.
